limitations: E adds one whole maximum observed complete workload prefix per recovery slot, plus unused headroom to the2MiB request-row ceiling; this conservatively covers late-round anomalies beyond the minimal fresh repository fixtures.
Maximum is across observed completed samples, not a mathematical upper bound for arbitrary conversation lengths, tools, provider bodies or future catalogs.
Stopped failed/unknown originals have no global count cap and can accumulate until quota. Fixed E is a stated scenario, not a production retention bound.
One active request per project was observed with8 concurrent refusals; retained old intents may remain after stopping their runs.
Quota guard rejects usage>limit; storage status is full at usage>=limit. No development quota changed.
Physical peaks are sampled SQL/stat observations and exclude application-library B1 files and initial kernel schema creation; no fs read/open of held DB files.
Checkpoint rewritten-column bytes exclude other SQL writes and physical write amplification. Network bytes are offline gateway request bodies, without sockets/headers/TLS/SSE.
